name: Seahorse
otherStatistics: Initiative +1 (11). Proficiency bonus +2. Perception +2. Stealth +5. Passive Perception 12. Languages none.
appearance: A small bronze-olive seahorse with a tubular snout, ringed sides and a tightly curled tail.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, revised Monster Manual (2025 release, 2024 rules), p. 369. https://www.dndbeyond.com/monsters/5195199-seahorse
sections.Traits: Water Breathing. The seahorse breathes only underwater.
sections.Actions: Bubble Dash. While underwater, the seahorse can move up to its swim speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

name: Spider
otherStatistics: Initiative +2 (12). Proficiency bonus +2. Stealth +4. Darkvision 30 ft. Passive Perception 10. Languages none.
appearance: A small olive-brown orb-weaver with a rounded, marked abdomen and eight slender legs.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, revised Monster Manual (2025 release, 2024 rules), p. 369. https://www.dndbeyond.com/monsters/4775844-spider
sections.Traits:
Spider Climb. Climb difficult surfaces and ceilings without an ability check.
Web Walker. Ignore movement restrictions from webs. The spider knows where other creatures are touching the same web.
sections.Actions: Bite. Melee attack roll +4, reach 5 ft. On a hit, deal 1 piercing damage plus 2 (1d4) poison damage.

name: Swarm of Bats
classification: Large swarm of Tiny Beasts, unaligned
otherStatistics: Initiative +2 (12). Proficiency bonus +2. Resistance to bludgeoning, piercing and slashing. Immunity to Charmed, Frightened, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Prone, Restrained and Stunned. Blindsight 60 ft. Passive Perception 11. Languages none.
appearance: A loose cluster of small brown bats with spread leathery wings and varied flight postures.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, revised Monster Manual (2025 release, 2024 rules), p. 370. https://www.dndbeyond.com/monsters/5195222-swarm-of-bats
sections.Traits: Swarm. Other creatures can share the swarm’s space and it can share theirs. The swarm can move through an opening that admits a Tiny bat. It cannot regain HP or gain temporary HP.
sections.Actions: Bites. Melee attack roll +4, reach 5 ft. On a hit, deal 5 (2d4) piercing damage, or 2 (1d4) while the swarm is Bloodied.

name: Swarm of Insects
classification: Medium swarm of Tiny Beasts, unaligned
speed: 20 ft., climb or fly 20 ft. (DM’s choice)
otherStatistics: Initiative +1 (11). Proficiency bonus +2. Resistance to bludgeoning, piercing and slashing. Immunity to Charmed, Frightened, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Prone, Restrained and Stunned. Blindsight 30 ft. Passive Perception 8. Languages none.
appearance: A spiral cluster of small dark insects with scattered winged forms.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, revised Monster Manual (2025 release, 2024 rules), p. 370. https://www.dndbeyond.com/monsters/5195224-swarm-of-insects
sections.Traits:
Spider Climb. If the swarm has a climb speed, it climbs difficult surfaces and ceilings without an ability check.
Swarm. Other creatures can share the swarm’s space and it can share theirs. The swarm can move through an opening that admits a Tiny insect. It cannot regain HP or gain temporary HP.
sections.Actions: Bites. Melee attack roll +3, reach 5 ft. On a hit, deal 6 (2d4 + 1) poison damage, or 3 (1d4 + 1) while the swarm is Bloodied.

name: Swarm of Piranhas
classification: Medium swarm of Tiny Beasts, unaligned
otherStatistics: Initiative +3 (13). Proficiency bonus +2. Resistance to bludgeoning, piercing and slashing. Immunity to Charmed, Frightened, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Prone, Restrained and Stunned. Darkvision 60 ft. Passive Perception 8. Languages none.
appearance: A school of deep-bodied, sharp-toothed fish with olive-gray backs, silver sides and rusty red undersides.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, revised Monster Manual (2025 release, 2024 rules), p. 370. https://www.dndbeyond.com/monsters/5195227-swarm-of-piranhas
sections.Traits:
Swarm. Other creatures can share the swarm’s space and it can share theirs. The swarm can move through an opening that admits a Tiny piranha. It cannot regain HP or gain temporary HP.
Water Breathing. The swarm can breathe only underwater.
sections.Actions: Bites. Melee attack roll +5, reach 5 ft. Roll with advantage if the target is below its HP maximum. On a hit, deal 8 (2d4 + 3) piercing damage, or 5 (1d4 + 3) while the swarm is Bloodied.
